items.title: FedEx (FDX) Shareholders Will Vote On Three Governance Proposals
items.summary: FedEx (NYSE: FDX) will face multiple shareholder proposals on board chair independence, shareholder powers, and product distribution oversight at its upcoming annual meeting.
